source: Kaggle dataset federalreserve/interest-rates (Federal Reserve Interest Rates, 1954-Present)

columns.FFR_EFFECTIVE: effective federal funds rate, percent (the row dated day 01)
columns.INFLATION: inflation rate, percent, as published in the dataset
columns.REAL_GDP_GROWTH: quarterly real GDP growth, percent (SA rate of change); blank except in the first month of a quarter

period_matched: each value describes its own row's month; NOT shifted for publication lag (the policy study applies a one-month delay)
